title: A lower bound for two-interval quantum backflow
summary: An explicit compactly supported positive-momentum state yields a summed backflow greater than 0.06190 over two unit-duration intervals separated by a gap of 3/2, in units where the reduced Planck constant is 1 and the mass is 1/2. An executable numerical certificate encloses its value approximately between 0.0619551065 and 0.0619551266, conditional on stated arithmetic and library assumptions. The state is defined by stored binary-rational coefficients and is re-integrated with enclosed quadrature and rounding errors. This is a trial-state lower bound, not an optimality result.
